definitions.gloss: drunk driving; driving under the influence (DUI)
definitions.explanation: Operating a motor vehicle after consuming alcohol. A serious criminal offense in Japan, with penalties applying not only to the driver but also to those who provide alcohol to the driver or ride as passengers.

examples.japanese: {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}は{絶対|ぜったい}にやめましょう。
{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}で{逮捕|たいほ}された。
examples.english: He was arrested for drunk driving.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}では{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}の{罰則|ばっそく}が{年々|ねんねん}{厳|きび}しくなっている。
examples.english: In Japan, the penalties for drunk driving have been getting stricter year by year.

notes:
{飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん} refers to operating a motor vehicle after consuming alcohol — a serious criminal offense in Japan.

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Japan has some of the strictest drunk driving laws in the world. The legal blood alcohol limit is 0.03%, and penalties can reach 5 years in prison and fines up to 1 million yen.
- Liability extends beyond the driver: anyone who provides alcohol to someone they know will drive, and any passenger who knowingly rides with a drunk driver, also faces criminal penalties.
- The phrase 「{飲|の}んだら{乗|の}るな、{乗|の}るなら{飲|の}むな」 (If you drink, don't drive; if you drive, don't drink) is a well-known public-safety slogan.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}をする (to drive drunk)
- {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}で{捕|つか}まる (to be arrested for drunk driving)
- {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}の{取|と}り{締|し}まり (drunk driving crackdown)
- {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}{撲滅|ぼくめつ} (eradication of drunk driving)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {酒気帯|しゅきお}び{運転|うんてん}: driving with measurable alcohol in one's system (a slightly less severe legal category than {飲酒運転|いんしゅうんてん}).
- {代行運転|だいこううんてん}: the designated-driver service that drives both you and your car home.
